## About
Magant Auto Care is a neighborhood repair shop on S Norcross Tucker Rd in Norcross, GA. Our team is led by ASE-certified technicians, and we work on everything from small adjustments to major repairs.
When you bring your car in, we listen to what's going on, do a courtesy inspection, and talk through what we find before any work starts. You get clear options and transparent pricing so you can decide what makes sense.
We put God first in how we run the shop, and that shows up as honesty and fairness with every customer. It's a big part of why we hold a 4.9 rating from 168 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake service and repair: From routine brake maintenance to more complex brake system repairs.
- Alignment: Precision alignment to improve handling and help your tires wear evenly.
- Computer diagnostics: We track down warning lights and odd symptoms so you know what's wrong before you decide on repairs.
- Engine repair: Diagnosing and fixing engine problems so your car runs smoothly and reliably.
- Batteries and electrical: Battery testing, replacements and electrical system checks.
- Oil and filter service: Regular oil and filter service to keep your engine healthy.
- AC service: Air conditioning inspection and service when your car isn't cooling right.
- Fleet service: Maintenance for businesses that run more than one vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: How often should I get an oil change?
A: Generally every 3,000 to 5,000 miles, but check your owner's manual for your car's specific interval. Driving conditions can change how often you need it.

Q: Why is my check engine light on?
A: It can mean anything from a minor issue to a serious one. The best move is to have us diagnose it so we can find the exact problem.

Q: How often should I get my wheels aligned?
A: We recommend an alignment once a year, or sooner if you notice steering or tire problems.

Q: Can I bring my company's vehicles to you?
A: Yes. We offer fleet services for businesses with multiple vehicles. Give us a call to talk through what your fleet needs.
